subject: Problems, Emergencies & Repairs
english: I would rather report this properly now than discover later that I should have done so earlier.
portuguese: Prefiro comunicar isto devidamente agora do que descobrir mais tarde que o devia ter feito antes.
pronunciationNote: preh-FEE-roo koh-moo-nee-KAR EES-too deh-vee-dah-MEN-t ah-GOH-rah doo k desh-koo-BREER mysh TAR-d k oo deh-VEE-ah tair FAY-too AN-tsh

exampleSentences.portuguese: Assim fica tudo registado desde o início.
exampleSentences.english: That way everything is recorded from the start.

subject: Problems, Emergencies & Repairs
english: If I describe the symptoms one by one, it may be easier to identify the real cause.
portuguese: Se eu descrever os sintomas um por um, talvez seja mais fácil identificar a causa real.
pronunciationNote: s eh-oo desh-kreh-VAIR oosh SEEN-too-mash oom poor oom, tal-VEHZ ZHAY-gah mysh FAH-seel ee-den-tee-fee-KAR ah KOW-zah heh-AL
notes: Useful in repairs and health issues.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não sei o nome técnico, mas sei o que noto.
exampleSentences.english: I do not know the technical name, but I know what I notice.

subject: Problems, Emergencies & Repairs
english: I am trying not to make assumptions, but it feels as though the problem started after the last repair.
portuguese: Estou a tentar não tirar conclusões, mas parece-me que o problema começou depois da última reparação.
pronunciationNote: esh-TOH ah ten-TAR nown tee-RAR kong-kloo-ZOYNSH, mahz pah-REH-s-m k oo proh-BLAY-mah koh-meh-SOH deh-POYSH dah OOL-tee-mah reh-pah-rah-SOWN

exampleSentences.portuguese: Pode ser coincidência, mas achei melhor mencionar.
exampleSentences.english: It may be a coincidence, but I thought it was better to mention it.

subject: Problems, Emergencies & Repairs
english: I do not need certainty right away, but I do need a sensible plan for what to do next.
portuguese: Não preciso de certezas imediatas, mas preciso de um plano sensato para saber o que fazer a seguir.
pronunciationNote: nown preh-SEE-zoo d sair-TEH-zash ee-meh-dee-AH-tash, mahz preh-SEE-zoo d oom PLAH-noo sen-SAH-too PAH-rah sah-BER oo k fah-ZAIR ah seh-GEER

exampleSentences.portuguese: Isso já me deixava muito mais tranquilo.
exampleSentences.english: That alone would make me much more at ease.

subject: Problems, Emergencies & Repairs
english: As far as I can tell, nothing is actively on fire, but the smell is strong enough to worry me.
portuguese: Pelo que consigo perceber, nada está ativamente a arder, mas o cheiro é suficientemente forte para me preocupar.
pronunciationNote: PEH-loo k kon-SEE-goo pair-SEH-bair, NAH-dah esh-TAH ah-tee-vah-MEN-t ah ar-DER, mahz oo SHAY-roo eh soo-fee-see-en-teh-MEN-t FOR-t PAH-rah m preh-oh-koo-PAR
notes: Useful with smoke or burning smells.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Por isso queria confirmar se é seguro ficar aqui.
exampleSentences.english: That is why I wanted to confirm whether it is safe to stay here.

subject: Problems, Emergencies & Repairs
english: If there is paperwork or a report that needs to be filed, I would rather do that sooner than later.
portuguese: Se houver alguma papelada ou relatório a preencher, prefiro tratar disso mais cedo do que mais tarde.
pronunciationNote: s oo-VER al-GOO-mah pah-peh-LAH-dah oh reh-lah-TOH-ree-oo ah preh-en-SHAIR, preh-FEE-roo trah-TAR DEE-soo mysh SAY-doo doo k mysh TAR-d
notes: Useful after theft, accidents, or damage.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Assim não corro o risco de me esquecer de algum detalhe.
exampleSentences.english: That way I do not risk forgetting some detail.

subject: Problems, Emergencies & Repairs
english: I know it is difficult to diagnose remotely, but even a rough first impression would help.
portuguese: Sei que é difícil diagnosticar à distância, mas até uma primeira impressão aproximada já ajudava.
pronunciationNote: say k eh dee-FEE-seel dee-ahg-nosh-tee-KAR ah deesh-TAN-see-ah, mahz ah-TAY OO-mah pree-MAY-rah eem-presh-SOWN ah-prok-see-MAH-dah zhah ah-zhoo-DAH-vah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Era só para perceber a gravidade provável.
exampleSentences.english: It was just to understand the likely seriousness.

subject: Problems, Emergencies & Repairs
english: Thank you for taking this seriously. It helps a lot when the response is clear and practical.
portuguese: Obrigado por levarem isto a sério. Ajuda muito quando a resposta é clara e prática.
pronunciationNote: oh-bree-GAH-doo poor leh-VAH-reng EES-too ah SAY-ree-oo. ah-ZHOO-dah MOOY-too KWAN-doo ah resh-POHSH-tah eh KLAH-rah ee PRAH-tee-kah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Assim sei melhor como proceder.
exampleSentences.english: That way I know better how to proceed.

subject: Problems, Emergencies & Repairs
english: Now that I understand the situation better, I can make a more sensible decision about what to do.
portuguese: Agora que percebo melhor a situação, posso tomar uma decisão mais sensata sobre o que fazer.
pronunciationNote: ah-GOH-rah k pair-SEH-boo meh-LYOR ah see-too-ah-SOWN, POS-soo toh-MAR OO-mah deh-see-ZOWN mysh sen-SAH-tah SOH-br oo k fah-ZAIR

exampleSentences.portuguese: Obrigado pela explicação. Foi muito útil.
exampleSentences.english: Thank you for the explanation. It was very useful.
